svg.text: SpecDriven app - module map & architecture review
v0.1.200 · src/ import graph (276 TS files, ~87k lines). Black = dependency / data flow. Red dashed = flaw. Red numbers -> notes on the right.
= public API is the whole app
thin facades: the code still lives
data loading, layout and dialogs in one file. Split by route.
api.ts: 3,351 lines, 92 routes in one table, 76 imports; also
owns startup sync and agent sessions. Plugins already mount
routes via routeRegistry - move core handlers the same way.
118 raw fetch() calls in 28 files. Wire types are imported
from fs-heavy modules (features.ts, pages.ts). Add shared/
server imports plugins/host 20x, host imports server 14x.
Plugins are neither above nor below the core.
sdk/client re-exports Menu, Toasts, ModalPrompts, route...;
sdk/host re-exports parser, fsx, git, run, automerge/store.
Every internal refactor is a breaking plugin change.
tests / issues / self-fix / pages wrap TestsPane, IssuesPane,
SelfFixPane, PagesPane that still live in frontend/ + server/.
The plugin boundary exists in name only.
only in names, + tokenStore.ts. One generic TokenStore<T>.
Behaviour forks scattered instead of one runtime profile.
wiring order lives in electron/main.ts and index.ts.
A change to parser.ts ripples through the whole app.
index.css: 9,701 lines in one global namespace.
git/ GitBackend (cli | gh | js) is swappable; routeRegistry
already lets plugins mount routes; 199 test files.
